# `toolu peers`

Communicate with peer agent sessions.

Owner: `plugins/toolu`.

## `toolu peers`

```text
Communicate with peer agent sessions

Usage: toolu peers [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  join    Enroll a fresh session in an authorized group
  send    Persist a message and attempt inbox delivery
  reply   Reply to an incoming message in its conversation
  inbox   Read a page of messages without acknowledging them
  status  Recover queued sends and inspect receipts
  ack     Explicitly acknowledge an incoming message
  list    Discover active members of this group
  leave   Retire this session without deleting messages
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json               Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
      --session <session>  Saved peer identity; defaults to TOOLU_PEERS_SESSION
  -q, --quiet              Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>        The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>   Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help               Print help
```

```text

Usage: toolu peers join [OPTIONS] --group <group> --machine <machine> --agent <agent>

      --machine <machine>
  -q, --quiet                Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --agent <agent>        [possible values: claude, codex, muse, cursor, opencode]
      --host <HOST>          The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse, opencode]
      --config-dir <DIR>     Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
      --key-file <key-file>
  -h, --help                 Print help
```
